oracle.rationale: The title promises the compost panel is hidden after the tab switch, but only the newly shown harvest panel is asserted.
evidence: No assertion covers the compost panel after the harvest tab is activated, so the test passes while both panels remain visible.

oracle.rationale: The Locator click action is neither awaited nor returned, so the interaction is not sequenced before the assertion.
evidence: remindButton.click() starts an unobserved Promise; the following assertion can run against the empty draft.

oracle.rationale: A selector-based page.check bypasses the Locator API that Playwright recommends.
evidence: page.check('#swap-only-toggle') acts on a raw selector instead of page.locator('#swap-only-toggle').check().

oracle.rationale: The click is an element of an awaited Promise.all, and the write is both route-stubbed and proven by an awaited response.
evidence: The aggregate Promise.all is syntactically led by await, so the action Promise is observed; page.route controls the backend boundary.

oracle.rationale: The positional locator sits in a method whose name explicitly promises index access, and the spec routes its board interaction through the page object.
evidence: plotRowByIndex(index) documents the positional intent that the #10a method-name exemption requires.

oracle.rationale: The evaluate call reads getComputedStyle, which the Locator API cannot express, and carries a JUSTIFIED rationale; the collapse asserts both the hidden and restored states.
evidence: No document.querySelector appears; toBeHidden and toBeVisible cover both sides of the toggle, and the absence assertion targets a locator already proven visible.

oracle.rationale: A password literal is typed into the authentication form instead of coming from configuration.
evidence: The literal is followed immediately by the Sign in submission, so it is a real credential rather than input-acceptance test data.

oracle.rationale: A Cypress command return value is stored in a variable, which captures a Chainable rather than the yielded element.
evidence: cy.get(...) is assigned to tomatoRow; the later chain re-enqueues the query instead of reusing a resolved subject.

oracle.rationale: A module-level mutable counter in a support file persists across every test in the worker.
evidence: seededPlotSequence is declared at column 0 and incremented by the custom command, so labels depend on prior test execution.

oracle.rationale: The credential-shaped value comes from Cypress.env and the mutating request is intercepted and awaited by alias.
evidence: No credential literal appears, and cy.intercept plus cy.wait('@placeHold') control and prove the write boundary.

oracle.rationale: The assigned value is a Sinon spy, which Cypress returns synchronously, and the assertions pin a concrete count and a named entry.
evidence: cy.spy() is the documented exemption to the assigned-command-return smell, and have.length 3 can fail.

oracle.rationale: The module-level container is frozen reference data that no helper mutates, and the raw DOM read is a JUSTIFIED getComputedStyle the Cypress element API cannot express.
evidence: Object.freeze prevents cross-test mutation, and element lookup goes through cy.contains rather than document.querySelector.
